pages.text: The Beekeeper Armor is a specialized set of leather armor, reinforced with honeycombs. It not only provides decent protection but also offers unique bonuses that make handling bees much safer and more efficient.

pages.title: Set & Piece Bonuses
pages.text: $(l)Full Set Bonus$(): Bees will no longer become aggressive towards you, even if you attack them or harvest from their hives.$(br2)$(l)Helmet$(): Bees that are angry at other targets will calm down much faster.$(br)$(l)Chestplate$(): Increases the range at which bees are attracted to you when holding flowers.$(br)$(l)Leggings$(): When you take damage, a bonemeal effect is applied to plants in a small radius around you.$(br)$(l)Boots$(): Grants a slight speed boost when walking on dirt blocks.
